title: T.T.O. (Official Video)
description: Official music video for 'T.T.O.' — taken from the album Conflict::States (2021).
lyrics:

Everyone must now suffer

Take them out

Take them out
But we don't know who they are

Your world, an empty core with nothing to live for

My mind can’t understand, too sick to comprehend,
It’s so out of control
Insane, to every word, hold on, absurd
This pain can’t last forever
No, we’re not condemned

In these days, these times, the suicides and insane minds

title: Pioneers (Official Video)
description: Official music video for 'Pioneers' — taken from the album Conflict::States (2021). Uber Rock Video of the Week. "This song is about all the people out there that truly believe in something and are bravely defiant, continually fighting till what they believe in is accepted by society." — Mark
lyrics:
We are alone, we’ll die as amateurs, not pioneers
No-one is on our side
We’ve no control, we don’t fit your mould, ignored by everyone
Are we dead, are we alive?

No, we are not real-life
Redefine everyone

I tore through dark; to tear you apart

Controlling it all, creating obstacles and chemicals
We accept, now you deny

No, we are not real-life
Redefine everyone

No chance, no fear, watch us disappear

Your passing through

lyrics:

laying down our laws

Well it turns you on

We are free and young

I can’t be addicted to the time I waste on you

We are nothing at all

We, we just want it all
You can’t see or understand
That until you’re down from the upper hand

title: What Are You Waiting For? (Official Video)
description: Official music video for 'What Are You Waiting For?' — taken from the début album 'Disasters: Ways To Leave A Scene' (2012). Directed by Nick Jewell.
lyrics:
Whatever you want, will bring you to your knees,
It goes against the rules,
It’s just an answer to your cause.
When all that you want, it won’t set you free,
An idea of mine,
Of never knowing space,
A waste of time.

Well on the outside, an answer is all you’ll seek,
Well you leave me no choice,
And now you’ll pay the price.
A debt you owe, but really do not need,
Caged within your cell,
You dig the hole yourself.

No I don’t wanna start a war,
What are you waiting for?
My insides are tired of crying,
Well I’m just out of time,
Well here we will,
Start a war,
What are you all waiting for?
A slow death that proves,
There’s nothing left to live for.

Well forgive me if it’s too hard to breathe,
These months have taken their toll,
The lies they do unfold,
Hold to the last chance that you’ll bring it home to me,
Well I’m losing my touch,
You’ve wanted this so much.

I'm not seeing it; just keep it to yourself,

I dunno why we try, try to understand the meaning,

With the ceilings caving in,
We’re watching,

Here, oh right here, In this world you call your own,
Well I could swear you could lose your mind,

Well if there’s a chance we can make it,

If I stay too long I won't be going home,
